articles.title: Zepwell Island
articles.intro: The largest island in the Kuzotz region, southwest of the Quon continent.
articles.body_html:
Areas

  • Eastern Altepa Desert
  • Western Altepa Desert
  • Rabao
  • Quicksand Caves
  • Chamber of Oracles
  • Cloister of Tremors

Getting there

  1. From Bastok Mines, enter Zeruhn Mines.
  2. Take the entrance into Korroloka Tunnel.
  3. Follow the tunnel maps to its Eastern Altepa Desert exit.

Open the area pages for maps, connecting passages and quest locations. The island is part of Kuzotz; it is not a separate playable zone.

articles.title: Zone Map Coordinates
articles.intro: Use the zone map to find a quest contact or route.
articles.body_html:
Read a map location

  1. Open the named zone page and its map gallery.
  2. Find the lettered column and numbered row. For example, G-7 means column G, row 7.
  3. Check the map number in multi-floor areas. The same grid square can refer to different floors.
  4. Follow the marked entrance or passage to the correct floor. A roaming monster can move within or beyond its listed spawn square.
